name: Himitsu no Hanazono
source:
A high-school student named Kousuke had a dream, in which he saw a beautiful woman talking to him. The next morning he found out that the new teacher looked very similar to the woman he saw. After overhearing a conversation, Kōsuke realizes that the new teacher is in fact a detective sent to investigate the murder of a female student that occurred in the gym. The young man has to play his cards right in order to become part of the investigation, solve the mystery, and perhaps impress the attractive teacher in other ways.

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/55137/himitsu-no-hanazono/]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
高中生Kousuke做了一个梦，梦中一名美丽女子正在对他说话。第二天早晨，他发现新来的老师与梦中女子极为相似。偷听到一段谈话后，Kousuke意识到这名教师其实是侦探，被派来调查体育馆中发生的一起女学生谋杀案。年轻人必须巧妙行动，才能参与调查、破解谜团，或许还能通过其他方式给这位魅力出众的老师留下印象。
